name: arch
description: The owner's technology-selection knowledge base: decision frameworks with their reasons, one skill per domain.
shortDescription: Technology-selection decision frameworks, one skill per domain.
longDescription: Arch sediments the owner's technology-selection judgment as skills — decision frameworks that record how to choose and why, so an agent can apply the settled defaults or deviate for stated cause. The first skill, arch-monorepo, covers repository structure: default to one monorepo per context with pnpm + turborepo, a packages/ + apps/ layout, changesets fixed versioning, and the repository baseline (audience-split docs, wiki/ knowledge base, format/lint floor, and a neutral .agents/skills directory with .claude/skills symlinked to it). Further domains such as web and server land as sibling skills over time.
defaultPrompt: Use arch-monorepo to set up this project with my baseline practices.
Use arch-monorepo to decide how to structure this repository.
Use arch-monorepo to align this repo with my conventions.
